finding.issue: The step requires status complete in both returned result and tab UI, but ordinary Chrome tab UI does not display the tabs API status field.
finding.correction: After navigate, run list_open_tabs with {} in Tools, locate the same owned tab ID, and require its status=complete alongside returned status=complete and the visually loaded Web form. Treat absence or loading as inconclusive or failure.
finding.evidence: src/lib/tools/handlers/tabs.ts:38-64 returns id and status; src/lib/tools/handlers/action.ts:18-30 returns navigation status; src/features/tools/ToolsView.tsx:390-491 exposes manual output.

verdict_B_quality_and_coverage.decision: The corrected procedures may be used as direct-handler test guidance if the navigation status instruction is corrected and the CDP type positive remains conditional. Preserve the original inventory permissions dimension and all unverified member/admin cells. A separate dispatcher route and Deny observation are required for permission coverage; source review and Tools Run do not supply them.

No positive, reload, member, admin, debugger attach, focus, dispatcher refusal or permission outcome is verified by this review.
